headline: As of 2026-10-20: 12,834,408 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 41 of 50 states, D+17.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 12,834,408 early/mail ballots cast so far across 41 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+17.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,523,009), Florida (1,245,792), Georgia (1,074,577).
